title: WorkPulse CDC overtime_requests row v1
description: Captured `overtime_requests` columns for the overtime fact. `hours` keeps ADR 0017's decimal-as-string encoding; notes and decision text never cross.

tenant_id.description: Tenant the row belongs to — enforced end-to-end.

employee_id.description: Employee the claim belongs to (UUIDv7 string).

work_date.description: Day the overtime was worked, Debezium epoch-day encoding.

hours.description: Approved-claim hours as a decimal string (`decimal.handling.mode=string`, ADR 0017) — e.g. "2.50". Never a float.

status.description: Overtime state-machine status. The projection maps `included_in_payroll` to the existing `hr_verified` fact state.
